"""Independent cell/scanner and inverse-recurrence small controls."""
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,platform,resource,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(120,120));resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(1024**3,1024**3))
start=time.monotonic();stamp=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();root=Path('/home/ryan/rule30-lab');sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

assert sha(r['source_text'].encode())==r['result_hashes']['source_sha256']
assert sha(r['admission_note_snapshot'].encode())==r['inputs']['proofs/informal/problem1_all_residue_memory_rigidity.md']
for name,h in r['inputs'].items():
 if name!='proofs/informal/problem1_all_residue_memory_rigidity.md':assert sha((root/name).read_bytes())==h
def G(x,g):
 n=x.bit_length()+3;b=[(x>>i)&1 for i in range(n)];out=0
 for i in range(n):
  v=b[i]^int((i>0 and b[i-1])or(i>1 and b[i-2]))
  if i==0 and g!='t':v^=1
  if i==1 and g=='p'and x%2==0:v^=1
  out|=v<<i
 return out
for x,values in {0:[0,1,3],1:[7,6,6],2:[14,15,13],3:[13,12,12]}.items():assert[G(x,g)for g in'tup']==values
for v,s,out in r['results']['sections']:assert G(4*v+s,'t')>>2==out==G(v,'tupp'[s])
for y,oldx,z in r['results']['rotations']:
 bits=[]
 for j in range(6):bits.append(((y>>j)&1)^int((j>0 and bits[j-1])or(j>1 and bits[j-2])))
 x=sum(bit<<j for j,bit in enumerate(bits));assert x==oldx and G(x,'t')%64==y
 assert G(x,'p')%64==z==4*(y>>2)+(y-1)%4
scanner_checks=0
def pair(q,g,b,age):
 global scanner_checks
 for _ in range(age):
  end=G(q,g);h='tupp'[end%4];nq=G(q,'t')>>2
  assert G(nq,h)==G(end,'t')>>2
  q,g=nq,h;scanner_checks+=1
 return[q%(1<<b),g]
for group in r['results']['uniform_groups']:
 b=group['b'];age=group['r'];base=group['base'];g=group['generator'];tab=[0]*(3*(1<<b))
 for z in range(1<<(2*age)):
  v,h=pair(base+(z<<b),g,b,age);tab[3*v+'tup'.index(h)]+=1
 assert tab==group['joint_counts']==[x for _ in range(1<<b)for x in [1,1,2]]
bad=[pair(z<<4,'t',4,2)for z in range(16)];assert bad==r['results']['early_control_pairs']
assert all(h=='t'for _,h in bad)and sorted(v for v,_ in bad)==list(range(16))

classes=[(c['residue'],c['end_mod16'])for c in fixed['results']['terminal_classes']]
